Turkmen words 201–300

Words 201 to 300 of the Daily Turkmen deck, in the deck's order, each with its meaning in English, an example sentence and, for verbs, the main forms (he, she or it). 85 of them are taught in the lessons of the course.

Learn them with spaced repetition, Anki-style: open the flashcards. Free, no account needed.

About this list

These are the 1,000 words of the Daily Turkmen flashcard deck, in the deck's order: roughly how common each word is. The ranks are an editorial estimate, not a count from a Turkmen corpus. Words are listed in their dictionary form (verbs in the infinitive, gelmek; nouns in the nominative singular).

The order is adapted from the deck of Daily Turkish, the sister course, which is itself adapted from the 2018 Turkish list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, made from the OpenSubtitles2018 corpus: each word was matched by meaning to its usual Turkmen equivalent, then the list was edited by hand. The order is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The meanings, example sentences and notes are original to Daily Turkmen.
